Class SceneRouter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.view.gui.SceneRouter
public class SceneRouter extends Object
Router class for managing GUI scenes and navigation. This class handles switching between different views and displaying overlays, alerts, and notifications.
